content_text:
About Us
AVADA Traffic is a leading traffic management operator and ancillary service provider with an established and extensive network of companies throughout Australia and New Zealand. AVADA Traffic provides services to government clients and major contractors in the civil infrastructure and maintenance sector.
The organisation is on a significant growth curve and is seeking candidates wanting to learn and grow with the company, challenge themselves and enjoy the rewards of working with similar people driven for team success.
Role Purpose
The purpose of the Traffic Management Designer role is to develop safe, efficient, and compliant traffic management plans (TMPs) for roadworks, events, construction projects, and other situations requiring temporary or permanent changes to traffic flow. This role will be based with our Victorian team out of the Yarraville depot. 
Key Accountabilities
- Design of detailed and compliant Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) and Traffic Guidance Schemes (TGS)
- Adhere to and design plans to the relevant regulatory authority, codes and standards.
- Collaborate with supervisors and regional managers to ensure efficient design of plans 
- Adapt designs to site specific requirements or unexpected changes 
- Implement company approved systems to ensure efficient and proactive approach to plan designs. 
- Ensure all client requirements and documentation is completed.
Suitable candidates will be able to demonstrate:
- Experience as a traffic management designer, TGS and TMP design.
- Experience designing in Rapid Plan or similar 
- Strong knowledge of traffic management plans and safety protocols.
- Hold Current TMD1. TMD2 and preferable TMD3 
- Preferred experience in external permit process, including MOA submissions
- Strong MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel).
- Strong organisational and time management skills ensuring operational activities remain on time and within budget.
- Effective communication skills and ability to give feedback (positive/ negative) to team members.
- Well-honed Client relationship skills to ensure provision of excellent service.
- High personal integrity.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and integrity.
- Ability to develop effective relationships and influence others.
- Have a strong knowledge of AGTTM
What we offer:
- Opportunities for professional growth and development.
- A supportive and collaborative work environment.
- The chance to make a real impact on traffic safety and efficiency.
Applications are welcome from candidates that want to be a part of an organisation that values safety awareness and appropriate workplace behaviours. At AVADA, you are not just a number, you are a part of a supportive team with opportunities for progression and development extending across Australia and New Zealand.
As an equal-opportunity employer, we value diversity and encourage applications from all personnel who are committed to a physically and mentally safe workplace.
